title: When the Orchard Sings
author: Jonah Yarrow
blurb: Tamsin Fairweather, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
